script.title: "Run out of" – what it really means

lines.text: Ran out? Where did it go?
Run out of means there's none left. We have no oat milk today.
Oh no! We've run out of coffee at home too.
Kit's tip: say run out of before the thing: we ran out of milk.
Learn more phrasal verbs on lexkite.com
